description: Change files on an existing site. Default mode 'patch' writes only the listed files and keeps the rest; `delete: [paths]` removes files. mode:'replace' deletes every file not listed. Preview with dryRun:true. Use deploy_site instead to create a new site. A 100-250 KB text file fits in one call with encoding:'gzip+base64' (gzip locally, then base64); prefer that over begin_deploy plus add_file_chunk. Fails with SITE_NOT_FOUND when the site does not exist.

delete.description: Patch mode only: site-relative paths to remove; other files stay. Combine with `files` to rename in one call. Rejected in replace mode.

dryRun.description: Validate and preview without writing; deletedFiles lists what would be removed. Use it before replace mode or a patch with `delete`.

anyOf.description: Array form; needed for binary files.

content.description: File content: text, or base64 as set by encoding.

encoding.description: utf8 (default): text written as is. base64: required for binary files (images, fonts, PDFs), otherwise the file is stored as broken text. gzip+base64: gzip locally, then base64; fits 3-5x more text per call.

path.description: Path relative to the site root, e.g. index.html or assets/app.js. Plain ASCII, no leading slash.

anyOf.description: Map form: path to UTF-8 text.

files.description: Files to write: `[{path, content, encoding?}]` (preferred) or a `{path: content}` map. <= 500 MB total. May be omitted for a delete-only call in patch mode.

mode.description: patch (default): write only the listed files; everything else stays. replace: delete every existing file and write only the listed ones.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: update_site

customHeaders.description: Result of syncing the _headers file in the site root (site-wide /* response headers).

deletedFiles.description: Files removed by this call: the `delete` entries that existed (patch), or every file not in `files` (replace).

dryRun.description: True on a dry run: nothing was written or deleted.

manageUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user manages this site (domains, versions, settings). Omitted on dry runs.

mode.description: The mode that was actually applied.

title: Update an existing site
